title: Pixel Earth's Enchanted Survival
description: A modpack designed to make Minecraft survival more fun, immersive, and rewarding with improved exploration, world generation, and gameplay features.
body:

Pixel Earth's Enchanted Survival is a vanilla-friendly modpack built to improve performance, interface usability, and visual feedback while maintaining standard Minecraft survival gameplay.

## Features & Included Mods

### Performance & Core Libraries
* **Sodium:** Replaces the rendering engine to improve FPS and frame stability.
* **Lithium:** Optimizes physics, chunk loading, and entity AI.
* **Fabric API / Fabric Language Kotlin:** Required files for modern Fabric mods to operate.
* **Cloth Config API / YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL):** Standard configuration systems for in-game mod menus.

### Visuals & Graphics
* **Iris Shaders:** Enables shader compatibility alongside Sodium performance.
* **3D Skin Layers:** Adds 3D depth rendering to player skin layers.
* **LambDynamicLights:** Items like torches emit light when held in the hand.
* **Visuality:** Adds ambient particle effects for entities and environmental actions.
* **Particle Rain:** Changes vanilla precipitation to physics-based particle rain and snow.
* **Zoomify:** Adds a configurable zoom function.

### Audio & Interface Immersion
* **Sound Physics Remastered:** Adds acoustic echoes and sound attenuation depending on block layouts.
* **Chat Heads:** Displays player skin heads next to chat messages.

### Quality of Life (QoL)
* **AppleSkin:** Displays hunger depletion metrics and saturation on the HUD.
* **Better Advancements:** Expands and cleans up the UI layout of the advancements screen.
* **Carry On:** Allows moving tile entities (like chests) and passive mobs by hand.
* **Cherished Worlds:** Adds favoriting and pinning options to the world selection screen.
* **Enchantment Descriptions:** Adds explicit descriptions to enchanted item tooltips.
* **Jade:** Displays technical block and entity status information when looked at.
* **Just Enough Items (JEI):** Provides an interactive overlay for items and recipe lookups.
* **Language Reload:** Decreases language load times and enables multi-language searching.
* **Mod Menu:** Adds an in-game interface list to configure installed mods.
* **Mouse Tweaks:** Adjusts inventory management via dragging mechanics.
* **Shulker Box Tooltip:** Provides an item inventory preview when hovering over a Shulker Box.
* **Text Placeholder API:** Backend library for parsing string information across mods.

### Map & Mining Utilities
* **Xaero's Minimap & World Map:** Adds real-time coordinate tracking, minimap HUD, and world overview.
* **VeinMiner:** Adds a mechanic to mine full ore veins or trees simultaneously.

### Dependencies
* **Geckolib, Prickle, Silk:** Structural animation and backend systems needed for specific mods to load.
